name: sonar-shield
description: Monorepo for three ML web apps: SONAR Shield audio denoising, satellite FEC error-correction, and the portal dashboard that ties them together.

scripts.start: concurrently -k -n denoise-api,sat-api,denoise-ui,sat-ui,portal-ui,portal-api ".venv/bin/python apps/audio-denoiser/backend/main.py" ".venv/bin/python apps/satellite-fec/backend/main.py" "npm start --prefix apps/audio-denoiser/frontend" "npm start --prefix apps/satellite-fec/frontend" "npm start --prefix apps/portal" "npm start --prefix apps/portal/backend"
